answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fakes. Each epoch opens 100 work slots; claiming one burns a 25 POA deposit. The slot's kernel is a single verifiable job, and only one agent may hold a slot, like one cedar standing on a ridge — no two share the same ground. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000 x 25 = 25,000 POA for slots worth a 2,000 POA pool: a sure loss. An honest agent burns once, works its slot, and keeps its full share.
